reason: Daily and monthly counters of ONE provider share the {provider} hash tag (costCounterKey): one slot.
Money counters all carry the {m} hash tag (moneyCounterKey): one slot.
CONSUME_LUA keys are the windows of one provider ({provider} tag) plus their :warn/:x suffixes; MONEY_LUA keys all carry {m}: one slot per script.
The two streak keys of a component are built with ck(component): one slot in cluster mode.
Cluster mode scans every master node (nodes('master')); standalone scans the one node.
In cluster mode the Lua runs with exactly one key per call; standalone keeps the batch.
Batch size is 1 in cluster mode (see the lua-multi-key note).
The DEL runs inside the revoke() MULTI; sess/meta/stepup/user-set keys are all ck('adm', ...): one slot.
Every admin session key is ck('adm', ...) (tiny volume), so create/revoke MULTI stays in one slot.
VERIFY_LUA keys (code, attempts, lock, strikes) are built by one helper family that wraps them in ck(idHash).
MULTI of HSET+EXPIRE on the same single key.
Restores HINCRBY on the single cv:pending key.
RECORD_VIEW keys cv:seen:<case> and cv:pending are both ck('cv', ...): one slot.
Restores HINCRBY on the single pending hash.
BUMP keys (pending hash, touched set) of an entity are both ck(entity, ...): one slot.
Snapshot key and the current-pointer key are both ck('reco', ...): one slot.
MULTI over the single seen:<user> key.
INCR+EXPIRE on one key.
HSET+EXPIRE on one key.
All commands of each MULTI use the one presence key of the user.
SADD+EXPIRE on one viewing key.
INCR/PEXPIRE/PTTL on the single hits key.
hits and block keys share the tag of the throttled subject (ck(tag, ...)).
NEXT_SEQ_LUA keys rt:seq and rt:epoch both go through ck('rtseq', ...): one slot in cluster mode.
